Subject: Data retention / deletion SLAs & log retention (follow-up)

Hi Jordan — great to speak this morning. Thanks for the time and for walking through Amaya's initial requirements. As promised, a short recap of the items we discussed and next steps related to retention/deletion and logs so your security and legal teams have a clear starting point.

Summary:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for 2025 (attached); scope covers the inference platform and control environment for hosted deployments.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads via BAAs; our platform supports customer-managed keys and audit logging. We are currently operating under our standard BAA process.
- GDPR: We support data portability and deletion requests; DPAs are available.

Data retention details (high level):
- Primary customer data (model inputs/outputs): default retention 30 days in active storage unless you configure shorter policies.
- Encryption keys & backups: backups are retained for disaster recovery and are typically rotated; snapshots/backups retained up to 90 days by default.
- Audit logs / request logs: retained for 365 days by default; we can offer extended log retention as an add-on.
- Deletion SLA (standard): for active data we target purging from primary storage within 30 days after a deletion request. Backups/snapshots are typically purged within a 90-day window depending on where a record sits in the backup lifecycle.

Open items / next steps:
1) Amaya to confirm whether the 30/90 default windows meet your compliance requirements or if you need shorter SLAs (e.g., immediate purge from backups within 30 days).
2) If required, we can start the vendor security questionnaire — I can send a secure link to your security contact (or you can upload to the shared drive link below).
3) I'll loop in Neha (security/compliance) and Rishi (product infra) for any technical follow-ups on log retention and backup process details.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview_2026.pdf, SOC2-type2-report-2025.pdf, Data-Retention-FAQ.docx

Thanks — happy to jump back on a call if it helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- For PHI we need confirmation that data subject deletion requests will be fully deleted from customer-visible storage within 14 days. Backups can be 90 days but we need a documented process describing how we surface and escalate deletion requests that appear in backups.
- SOC 2: thanks for the report — we'll have our security team review. Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 scope includes S3-compatible backups and snapshot processes?
- Logs: Amaya needs request logs retained 24 months for our audit team; is extended retention available as part of the Dedicated offering?

Also please send the vendor security questionnaire link to security@amaya.ai and I'll initiate it.

-Jordan

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Jordan's reply. Key asks for us to answer: 14-day deletion confirmation for PHI from active storage, confirmation whether SOC 2 scope includes backup snapshots, and 24-month log retention availability.

My notes / recommended answers:
- Deletion SLA: we can commit to removing customer data from active storage within 14 days for PHI if Amaya signs the BAA and requests the accelerated deletion SLA as part of the contract addendum. Backups: we cannot guarantee immediate zeroization of all backup snapshots on arbitrary request due to restore/DR policies, but we can commit to a documented backup retention schedule with a maximum backup retention window of 90 days. For records that are removed from primary storage, they will be marked for removal and will be purged from backups in the next backup retention cycle (<= 90 days).
- SOC 2 scope: the attached SOC2-type2-report-2025.pdf covers production services and the managed backup processes for the hosted inference offering; we should confirm the exact control IDs with Jordan's team if they want a control-mapping spreadsheet.
- Logs: extended retention (24 months) is available as a paid retention add-on for Dedicated customers; for Hosted we can offer it as an enterprise contract option with additional storage fees and egress considerations.

Action items:
- Marissa: share the vendor questionnaire DocuSign/link to security@amaya.ai (Jordan asked for this).
- Rishi: can you prepare a short technical note that outlines our backup lifecycle, snapshot rotation, and how deletions are flagged and purged? Target: same-day draft.
